description: Detect potential deadlocks in swarm message passing
rationale: Agents in a swarm must not form circular blocking dependencies; the compiler verifies message DAGs are acyclic

description: Consensus strategy must be achievable given swarm size
rationale: A `unanimous` consensus with size > 1 requires all agents respond; `majority` requires size >= 3 for meaningful voting

description: Swarm topology must be connected — no isolated agents
rationale: For `ring`, `mesh`, and `tree` topologies, the compiler verifies every agent is reachable from every other agent

description: Swarm inherits the union of its agents' required capabilities
rationale: A swarm dispatching to agents that require `llm` or `io` capabilities must itself hold those capabilities

description: Dispatch block input/output types must match agent handler signatures
rationale: The data scattered to agents must be compatible with the agent's handle() method signature

description: Aggregate block should handle partial results for fault tolerance
rationale: When on_failure is not defined, the aggregate block must handle the case where fewer results return than dispatched

description: Swarm operations compose effects from all constituent agents
rationale: A swarm combining agents with / llm and / io effects must declare both in its own effect signature

description: Message delivery order depends on topology
rationale: Star topology: hub sees all messages; ring: sequential ordering; mesh: no ordering guarantee; broadcast: simultaneous

description: Swarm size should be bounded to prevent resource exhaustion
rationale: Swarms without an explicit size or with size > 1024 generate a warning; use @perf contracts for large swarms

description: Swarm must not cascade failures across agents
rationale: An agent failure in a swarm must be isolated; the on_failure handler determines recovery (retry, skip, abort)

description: Broadcast topology with large swarms risks message storms
rationale: Broadcast to > 100 agents without rate limiting generates a warning; prefer scatter/gather patterns

description: Consensus operations should have explicit timeouts
rationale: A swarm with consensus but no timeout may block indefinitely; the compiler inserts a default 30s timeout if omitted

description: Agents in a swarm must be Send + Sync for safe concurrent dispatch
rationale: The compiler verifies agent types satisfy Send + Sync bounds before allowing swarm membership

description: Agent mode compression for swarm constructs
rationale: swarm→Σ/sw, topology→topo, consensus→cons in agent mode; human mode uses full keywords

description: Non-deterministic swarm operations should be annotated
rationale: Swarms with mesh topology or weighted consensus produce non-deterministic output; @inv contracts can constrain this
